attributes.name: Mathematical Abstraction
attributes.description: Represent problems with symbols, variables, and general structures.
weak_error_templates: Avoids symbolic setup; stays with concrete numbers only
Writes an expression that doesn't match the structure of the problem

attributes.name: Logical Reasoning
attributes.description: Follow multi-step deductive chains and justify steps.
weak_error_templates: Skips a logical step or reverses order of operations
Claims two unequal results are 'basically the same'

attributes.name: Mathematical Modeling
attributes.description: Translate word problems and contexts into mathematical form.
weak_error_templates: Misreads what the question is asking
Sets up the wrong equation or diagram from the story

attributes.name: Intuitive Imagination
attributes.description: Use spatial, visual, and intuitive sense-making (number lines, diagrams).
weak_error_templates: Number line or diagram drawn incorrectly
Relies on gut feel without checking scale or units

attributes.name: Mathematical Operation
attributes.description: Execute arithmetic and algebraic procedures accurately.
weak_error_templates: Arithmetic slip after correct method chosen
Applies operation to wrong part of the expression

attributes.name: Data Analysis
attributes.description: Interpret tables, graphs, and data displays.
weak_error_templates: Reads wrong row or column from a table
